programme.title: AmeriCarna - THE CORVETTE
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - ELVIS VAULT
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BAND OF BROTHERS
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Final Shot: The Hank Gathers Story
programme.desc: Inspired by his mother (Nell Carter) and a priest (George Kennedy) in Philadelphia, he (Victor Love) rises to basketball All-American at Loyola Marymount.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

programme.title: The Last Letter
programme.desc: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake.

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash).

programme.title: State Property 2
programme.desc: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone.

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life.

programme.title: Falcon Rising
programme.desc: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead.

programme.title: Blue Hill Avenue
programme.desc: Four friends enter the drug trade in Boston in the late 1970s: Tristan (Allen Payne), Money (Aaron D. Spears), E-Bone and Simon. With the consent of a South End crime boss, Benny (Clarence Williams III), they quickly rise in the drug game, while the leader of the group, Tristan, keeps his double life a secret from his clueless parents. However, as the 1970s pass to the 2000s, a police investigation threatens to ignite a violent feud among the tight-knit friends.

programme.title: Spirit Lost
programme.desc: The seductive ghost of a sea captain's abandoned lover haunts the beachside home of an artist and his wife.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail.

programme.title: Snoop Dogg's Hood of Horror
programme.desc: The Hound of Hell (Snoop Dogg) is a guide through three stories from a neighborhood of depraved citizens. There is a tagger who discovers that not all gangsters die hard, a foolish Texas oil fortune heir who kills for money but can't afford to stay living, and a huge rap star who uncovers a few skeletons in his dressing room that try to kick down his door.

programme.title: Stan Helsing
programme.desc: Stan (Steve Howey), a slacker video store clerk, his sexy girlfriend, best friend and an exotic dancer take a detour into a town cursed by the biggest monsters in movie history.

programme.title: Gallowwalkers
programme.desc: Aman (Wesley Snipes) is cursed in the womb, and as an adult, anyone he kills rises as the walking dead. Being relentlessly pursued, the gunfighter enlists the aid of a young warrior to confront the zombies.

programme.title: Repentance
programme.desc: A disturbed client (Forest Whitaker) uses torture to coerce a self-help author (Anthony Mackie) into confessing his untold crimes.

programme.title: Meet the Blacks
programme.desc: When some unexpected money comes his way, Carl Black moves his family from cold and windy Chicago to bright and sunny Beverly Hills, Calif. As the Blacks settle into their beautiful new home, they start to notice some strange behavior in the neighborhood. Nighttime is approaching, and President El bama announces that the annual purge is about to begin. Carl and his loved ones must now endure a 12-hour period of lawlessness before they can enjoy life once again.

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body.

programme.title: A Haunted House 2
programme.desc: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go.

programme.title: Rosemary's Baby
programme.desc: After a personal tragedy, Rosemary and Guy head to Paris, where Guy has landed a teaching job at the Sorbonne; the young couple realize their new apartment has a haunted past.

programme.title: Mi nombre es Gatillo
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

programme.title: El cachas de oro
programme.desc: Un conocido juez persigue a unos violadores y asesinos, hijos de Ramsés, y los mete a la cárcel, pero su padre los libera, por lo que el valiente juez se ve obligado a matarlos. Ramsés se vengará del juez matando a su prometida.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Mujer de Cabaret
programme.desc: La hermosa y popular cantante de un club nocturno es condenada injustamente por un asesinato.

programme.title: Los dos hermanos
programme.desc: Un hombre rico y poderoso está casado con una mujer mucho más joven, la cual tiene un amante.

programme.title: Amargo destino
programme.desc: Un hombre es encarcelado por un crimen ocurrido accidentalmente y, al salir libre, la mala suerte lo persigue.

programme.title: Condenados a Duelo
programme.desc: Dos hombres no se detendrán ante nada hasta cobrar venganza con la sangre del culpable.

programme.title: Los Humillados
programme.desc: Dos hermanos, uno compositor y el otro cantante, van a probar fama y fortuna a la capital.

programme.title: El Placer de la Venganza
programme.desc: Una doctora y su familia son agredidos durante un robo, y después se encuentra a un joven que tomó parte en el ataque.

programme.title: Porros, calles sangrientas
programme.desc: Una banda de delincuentes vende droga en una escuela secundaria y una maestra se atreve a denunciarlos.

programme.title: Secuestro
programme.desc: Urgido de dinero, un publicista (Richard Grieco) se suma a los planes de un secuestrador (Michele Greene).

programme.title: Caballos de acero
programme.desc: Un joven rico es aficionado al motociclismo y conoce a un teniente de la policía con quien rivaliza en aptitudes.

programme.title: Noche de muerte
programme.desc: Un delincuente se disfraza como un famoso luchador y asalta varios lugares matando a los guardias de seguridad.

programme.title: Acapulqueña
programme.desc: Un millonario decide montar un espectáculo con una mujer de Acapulco y dos hombres se enamoran de ella.

programme.title: Santo: Infraterrestre
programme.desc: Las fuerzas del bien se enfrentan a las malévolas intenciones de los Infraterrestres, seres de otro planeta que intentarán apoderarse de la Tierra.

programme.title: Adiós, New York, adiós
programme.desc: La ciudad de Nueva York es el escenario donde se juntan varias historias protagonizadas por latinos. Una familia puertorriqueña, dos mexicanos y sus amigos buscan fortuna sin olvidar sus raíces y tradiciones.

programme.title: El Mofles y Canek en máscara vs cabellera
programme.desc: Un mecánico inexperto en el deporte de la lucha libre vive toda una aventura cuando se enfrenta a un luchador asesino.

programme.title: Cacería implacable
programme.desc: Un hombre con mucha angustia trata de escapar de la tentación de la mafia representada por la perversión y las drogas.

programme.title: Con el Odio en la Piel
programme.desc: Un sheriff y sus malévolos secuaces humillan y asesinan a los mexicanos que viven en un pueblo fronterizo de Texas.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Players will lean over a ledge to collect flags, bob in rats, and cut cables off their hog-tied partner.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be lying on their backs in a muddy trough on the roof of a building. On "go" the contestants will be dragged through the mud and must pluck as many flags as they can before dropping off the edge of the building.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's being weighed down underwater, digging into rotten picnic snacks, and a tag-team challenge on a moving train.
programme.sub-title: Blind Date Fear Factor: Take Two

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must hang on as they are dragged through water, juice cow eyes with their mouths, and jump between moving trucks to gather flags.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: 2 poles will be attached and hung off the front end of a dump truck, contestants must make their way out on the pole pulling flags as they make their way to the end. Contestants will be standing on a car that is suspended over the water by a crane. The car is specially designed to rotate like a rotisserie.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In this episode we see stunts including the Leap on Faith, Pig Eat and High speed Climbing wall.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be seated in the driver's seat and truck of a stretch limousine suspended on a 45-degree angle just above the surface of the water. Contestants will have to transfer a gross blend of bugs through a plexiglass tube. Contestants are tied into their seat and to the steering wheel of a convertible automobile, which will be hanging over a cliff approx 100-feet in the air.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Family Episode - Players will walk on high beams, be buried in roaches, and catapult their children into a lake.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants go through the Fear Factor Triathalon. Contestants must guide their blindfolded partner through a maze of electrical tripwires designed to deliver a safe but shocking electrical charge when triggered. For every sprung tripwire, both contestants will receive a jolt.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Boat Jump As two ultra boats raced down a lake at 40 miles per hour, contestants would have to jump the gap between them that was approximately 7 feet wide and land on the second boat. Contestants who jumped from boat to boat successfully would advance to the next round.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Blimp Climb As a blimp flew high above the ocean, contestants would have to climb down a 35-foot rope ladder, release a flag, and climb back up the ladder. The two men and the two women to complete this stunt fastest would advance to the next round. The others would be eliminated.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will beam walk between helicopters, test bug shakes, and jump cars over trains.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: As a ferris wheel-like structure begins to move, the contestant must walk while keeping up with the constantly increasing speed of rotation. For the next challenge, a platform will start descending into the water until the contestants are completely submerged. They will have two locks that they must unlock to remove the chains to escape.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Tunnel Swim Contestants would have to swim through an underwater tunnel that was 80 feet long. Along the way, there were four air pockets. The two men and the two women to get through the tunnel the fastest would advance to the next round. The others would be eliminated.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will play a game to determine how many disgusting donuts they will have to eat along with a tall glass of curdled milk. Contestants will be standing on a truss structure that is approx. 20' above the water. On go, the contestants must make their way across each of the 3 sets of beams of various widths to pull flags at the opposite end of the structure.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: The contestants will be bound face to face by their wrists to a pole that is attached to a circular platform hanging under a helicopter. Two contestants are placed into a single plexiglass helmet filled with thousands of spiders. The contestants will be bound by their ankles to a platform which is attached to a lever that is weighted at the opposite end holding the platform in the air.

programme.title: Fear Factor 2.0 USA
programme.desc: In order to win they must face getting catapulted off the top of a tall building, transfer snakes with theirs mouths

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants become human wrecking balls, eat boiled testicles and rescue a fake baby from a submerging car.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: For the first stunt the six have to release up to 12 flags from the edges of an 8-foot by 24-foot see-saw platform over 100 feet in the air. The two men and the two women to release the most flags the fastest before falling would advance. Next stunt is to eat a penis, within 5 minutes, of either a deer, elk, bull, or water buffalo.
programme.sub-title: Counter Balance Beam/Weenie Roast/Swinging Rope Bridge

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Contestants hold on to a spinning suspended beam, and look for Fear Factor tokens in disgusting pies

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's launching into a net hanging from a helicopter, a race to eat worms and maggots, and collecting flags on top of a moving truck that's about to drive off a ship.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Players will be submerged in chains, and retrieve cow hearts and dunk them back out as a team.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must climb hand over hand around the skids of a moving helicopter, move maggots with their mouths, and attempt to flip their car the furthest on a pipe ramp.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's exploring a pig pen with their mouths, seeing how it feels to become a rotisserie chicken and a rotting milk escape attempt.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Vertical Gauntlet Contestants would have to cross 12-inch wide support beams between two 14-story buildings, climbing rope ladders to get from one beam to the next. On each beam, with the exception of the first, they would have to navigate an obstacle.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Twins Episode - Players will jump from helicopters and try to hit targets, rescue each other from bees, and rescue a dummy from a sinking car.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: For the first stunt contestants ride on the back of a speedboat as a helicopter flew overhead. They would grab a 20-foot rope ladder hanging from the helicopter and climb it. The two men and the two women to climb into the helicopter the fastest would advance.
programme.sub-title: Speedboat to Heli/Worm Transfer/Car Thru Building

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a suspended shoulder stand, facing off with a very dirty kitchen sink, and driving under a moving semi-truck.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In this stunt a rope will be suspended between two helicopters. On "go" the contestant must traverse the rope from beneath one helicopter to the other end of the rope beneath the other helicopter while releasing flags along the way. programme.title: Fear Factor USA

The menu includes Spicy Italian Style Vegetable Soup, Bruschetta with Ndjua - a crunchy country bread topped with a spicy sausage and a simple and delicious Skillet Peppers and Potatoes.
programme.sub-title: Spiced Up Soup and Salad Night

Her Spaghetti Caruso is made with a hearty sauce of mixed mushrooms, tomatoes, peas and chicken livers. She finishes with a unique dish of Rigatoni with Cauliflower, Saffron and Golden Raisins.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

She starts by making a flavorful chicken stock made into "Stracciatella", laced with eggs and spinach. She then uses the stock in her succulent Stuffed Veal Chop with oozing Fontina. Finally, she prepares a Braised Kale with Bacon, a wonderful dish that she has been eating since she was a child.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

Lastly there is still time for a delicious salad of poached seafood featuring shrimp, mussels and calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Whether used in soups, roasted or stuffed, the Italians love their vegetables. In this episode, she makes a platter full of Roasted Peppers Stuffed with Tuna. programme.desc: The life, ministry and message of Jesus Christ. Here is the story of His humble birth in a Bethlehem manger, His baptism in the River Jordan and of His calling of the disciples. Witness Jesus' temptation in the wilderness, the Sermon on the Mount, the healing of the blind and many miracles.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: In 1917, two little girls and one small boy claimed to see and hear the Virgin Mary near Fatima, Portugal. What did the Fatima children witness? Learn the surprising answers.
programme.sub-title: Apparition of Mary: Was There a Miracle at Fatima?

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: For 2,000 years the birth of Jesus has been celebrated. Can the New Testament solve the mysteries of Christmas? New evidence provides a surprising look at the first Christmas.
programme.sub-title: Christmas Miracle: What is the Real Story of Christmas?

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Even the Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Will an investigation into these so-called silent early years reveal that Jesus was aware of His own divinity . . . even as a child? Why is the record of most of His life missing? Are the so-called silent early years of Jesus really lost? Or has the truth never been told? The answers you'll find here may surprise you!

programme.title: The Living Bible Series
programme.desc: Joseph interprets a dream for Pharaoh and is then put in charge of the whole of Egypt.

programme.title: The Shroud: Face to Face
programme.desc: Robert Orlando's documentary portrays Jesus' crucifixion as a transformative true crime story. It uses New Testament insights, expert interviews, and digital recreations to examine the Shroud of Turin. Bloodstains align with gospel accounts, suggesting authenticity. Orlando hopes to renew interest in Christian history.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Who was Mary Magdalene? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or was she Christ's beloved disciple. An investigation into the mystery surrounding her identity produces startling insights. What message did the Virgin Mary bring to Fatima and reveal in 1917? A prophecy from biblical times? Learn the surprising answer.

programme.title: The Last Hours of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: From his arrest to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and eXperts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really dies on the cross? Follow this investigation on one of History's biggest mysteries.

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: James and Jude were the brothers of Jesus, who like Jesus, grew up in their father's carpenters shop in Nazareth. It was only after Jesus' death and resurrection that they became his followers, with James heading up the Jerusalem Church. Each of them wrote letters to the believers with James encouraging them to do good deeds as well as believe.

programme.title: I Believe In Easter
programme.desc: Learn how the church adapted and transformed pagan tradition into the celebration of the Resurrection. See how culture, emperors, apostles and popes have influenced how we celebrate Easter today.

programme.title: Scarlet Woman: The True Story of Mary Magdalene
programme.desc: Mary Magdalene is a familiar presence in modern culture. We've read about her in the Da Vinci Code. We've heard about her in Jesus Christ Superstar. We think we know the story well. Yet in actual fact we don't know it at all because it's all a fantasy. For a thousand years, the Mary Magdalene story has been one of art's most tremulous myths. In the Bible, she warrants just four actual mentions.

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: The Tomb of Jesus
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible (Widescreen)
programme.desc: The tragedy and victory of the New Testament. Follow Jesus through the Last Supper, His betrayal by Judas in Gethsemane, His trial before Pilate and the crowds, His Crucifixion, and the joyful triumph of His Resurrection and Ascension. He is Risen.

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: John was called by Jesus from the shores of the Sea of Galilee to come and follow him. For 3 years he was one of the inner-band of disciples, witnessing the transfiguration. After the death of Jesus, he was first at the tomb to discover that Jesus had risen. He became leader of the church at Ephesus where he wrote the Gospel of John. In the mines of Patmos, he had a wonderful vision of God.

programme.title: The Twelve Apostles: The First 12 Men Chosen By Jesus
programme.desc: Judas has been the symbol of evil and treachery but does he deserve this reputation? Why has he continued to fascinate writers, actors and artists? It is time to re-examine his role in the Jesus story and in the centuries that followed.

programme.title: Discovering Apostle Paul
programme.desc: Paul's background gave him a good understanding of Greek culture and philosophies. But to him the Gospel wasn't philosophy, it was truth and unlike the monasteries of Meteora, where monks hid their faith away, Paul engaged with the philosophers of his day in the market place. In Athens he was invited to address the Council of the Areopagus about the resurrection and 'Unknown God'.

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible (Widescreen)
programme.desc: Never-before-seen documentary footage takes you on an amazing adventure behind the scenes, to see first-hand how this epic multi-national production was filmed on the very ground where it happened From the Creation to the Resurrection, Heston captures the passion of the Bible through the power of the spoken word, the way its mysteries and legends were originally passed down for generations.
programme.sub-title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible: Behind the Scenes

programme.title: The Case for Christ
programme.desc: Lee Strobel's blockbuster bestseller comes alive on your screen in this documentary that chronicles the reporter's journey from atheism to faith. The former legal editor of the Chicago Tribune draws upon his investigative skills to examine the historical viability and accuracy of the Gospels, along with the personal claims and resurrection of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: My Son My Savior
programme.desc: From the makers of the award winning biblical dramas, Road to Emmaus and Come Follow Me, comes My Son, My Savior, a powerful portrayal of the life of Jesus as seen through the eyes of his mother, Mary.

programme.title: A Moment in History
programme.desc: Seth explores the final 24 hours in the life of Jesus Christ.
programme.sub-title: The Final 24 Hours of Jesus' Life

programme.title: The Living Bible Series
programme.desc: The Last Supper is the final meal that, in the Gospel accounts, Jesus shared with his Apostles in Jerusalem before his crucifixion.

programme.title: Come Follow Me
programme.desc: Come Follow Me dramatizes the relationship between Jesus and the Apostle Peter. From the day Peter heard Jesus call his name to the post-resurrection conversation in which Jesus charges Peter to 'feed my sheep,' this short film beautifully illustrates Peter's transformation from fearful denier to the bold leader of the early church.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: An investigation into the identity of Mary Magdalene, one the Bible's best known women, produces startling insights. Who was she? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or Christ's beloved disciple?
programme.sub-title: Biblical Women: Was Mary Magdalene a Saint or Sinner?

programme.title: Prophecies of the Passion
programme.desc: Prophecies of the Passion is an extraordinary look at the Messianic prophecies fulfilled during the final week of Christ's life on earth. The Gospels clearly describe Jesus' betrayal, arrest, death, and resurrection. Remarkably, these events were foretold by Hebrew prophets-in specific detail... centuries before they actually occurred.

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: St Peter's Basilica in Rome is the centre of the Roman Catholic faith. But the man who it is named after, knew nothing but fishing for the first part of his life. Following the death and resurrection of Jesus, Peter became a missionary of the Christian Church. From the shores of the Sea of Galilee to the might of Rome, Peter became one of the young churches first missionaries.

programme.title: Mystery of the Shroud
programme.desc: In a tomb located in Jerusalem's Hell Valley, on land bought with Judas Iscariot's bloodstained silver, a sensational discovery was made. Vital information has been uncovered to paint a picture of what Jesus' grave would have looked like and what his burial process involved. One of the key moments in Christian history is made real and contemporary through this exciting archaeological discovery.

programme.title: The Week That Changed The World

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens

programme.title: Animals of Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Thanksgiving. A most treasured holiday, and not just in the USA; it continues to be celebrated across the world in many different guises. These traditions are all united by a celebration of the harvest and the generosity of the natural world. Many animals have weird and wonderful connections to the holidays. Turkeys are one of the most iconic characters, but deer, lobsters and even eagles are also part of the feast.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying just off the coast of west Scotland, the Hebrides archipelago is made up of more than 500 islands and islets. Isolation from the mainland has made it the perfect breeding ground for millions of creatures, making it home to some of the largest gatherings, and greatest spectacles on the planet.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: The Royal Bengal Tiger is in it's most primeval form here in the Sunderbans. `The tangled mangroves along the tributaries of the river Ganga are one of the most fearsome forests of the World. The tigers could kill humans and eat them. The people living around the forests are also one of the poorest in the country. They have to go inside the forest to eke out a living by catching crabs and fish. And that's the opportunity the tiger may seek.

programme.title: Wild Indochinas - Wild heart
programme.desc: Indochina; three ancient kingdoms, Laos, Vietnam and Cambodia, linked by one great river: the mighty Mekong. A mystical land shaped by the forces of the monsoon. A region ravaged by war but, like a Phoenix, risen from the ashes. Within its boundaries can be found one tenth of the world's species, and some of the richest ecosystems on the planet. This is the land of the Mother River, one of the most bio diverse regions on Earth.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Bred from wolves, Huskies have helped humans carve out an existence in Alaska's desolate wilderness. These dogs still maintain many physical adaptations of their wild ancestors, enabling them to withstand the fierce conditions of the Alaskan winter. And in Alaska's most extreme terrain, sled dogs are still the only form of transport. In the south, the modern city of Anchorage is still home to the start of the World's Toughest Race, a 1000 mile sled-dog race, known as the Iditarod.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: On the savannah of southern Africa, rains have turned the land green and lush. It's the time of plenty and for the cast of wild characters here, cashing in is priority number one. From polecat to aardwolf, some of the continent's most seldom seen creatures are out to make the most of the abundance. Some families gorge on the plentiful grasses, while for others there's no such thing as an easy meal, even at this time of year.

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving - but though always on the move they're not exactly speedy.

programme.title: Seals - Clowns of the Sea
programme.desc: Much loved clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Even though they're not much more than bloated sausages on land, they're agile hunters and supremely graceful in the water. They en-tertain us with dramatic courtships, an endlessly playful sense of curiosity and some of the cutest babies on the planet.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Deep in the Southern Ocean, the Snares islands are one of the most pristine island wildernesses left on the planet. Every summer, millions of seabirds converge here to breed. More than 50,000 endemic Snares crested penguins battle massive Southern Ocean swells to come ashore. Deep in the forest they find their mates and raise their chicks in a frantic race to take advantage of the short subantarctic summer.

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, heaviest, fastest, slowest - even the rarest. The creatures that hold the records for these categories are some of the most interesting in the natural world. Some are familiar and iconic, but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers. These quirky and unusual animals that often go ignored are inventive, ingenious and awe-inspiring.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: This episode explores nature's deadliest killers. From a tiny but deadly insect, to a pod of hungry Orca's, predators come in all sizes, and are found on every continent on earth. Chasing, stalking, ambushing or using camouflage, the way each predator hunts, catches and kills food is determined by many factors, including the anatomical adaptations of both the predator and the prey.

programme.title: Hidden UK
programme.desc: For its tiny size the UK is a hugely varied landscape with a surprising collection of remarkable and awe-inspiring wildlife.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to a huge number of wild porcupines, living in the city's parks, gardens and streets. Almost twice the average size, Anchorage's porcupines search for food here in the city, and find refuge during the bitter Alaskan winters. But life on the streets also takes its toll.Porcupines are the city's number one roadkill. In the wild, few animals other than wolves attempt to kill porcupines, and in the city, domesticated dogs can be as big a threat to the porcupines as wild wolves.

programme.title: Nature's Cutest
programme.desc: As we all know the natural world can be tough and challenging at times, but it can also be nothing short of adorable. Fluffy white seals, wobbly-kneed fawns, playing polar bear cubs, adorable teddy bear-like koalas - so much cute it would be impossible to decide which was the most adorable. But why do we consider some animals cute and others not? What it is about them that makes us fall in love? Perhaps it's those animals that remind us of ourselves?

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The Amazon. A magnificent broad-leafed rainforest. The heart of Brazil. The Amazon basin covers an impressive 7 million square kilometres. Rainforests are often known as the lungs of our planet. The Amazon Rainforest is the largest. Its value in terms of the Oxygen that it provides, and the Carbon Dioxide that it consumes is immeasurable. It is home to splendid, exquisite plant and animal species. The most diverse and numerous array of species found anywhere in the world.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Grasslands cover nearly fifty percent of the African continent. African grasslands support vast and diverse wildlife. Due to the open and uncovered nature of grassland, predators are much easier to spot, giving smaller animals a chance to run away, hide and survive. Thanks to the lack of hiding places for predators, the African savannah regions support a much greater diversity of wildlife than temperate grasslands.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The Arctic is alive with a fascinating assortment of wildlife and species that are unique to this Polar environment. Most of are rarely or never seen outside the Arctic Circle. They live and thrive in a hostile environment of ice, polar desert, wind-swept open tundra, ancient glacial formations, sub zero sea temperatures and an incredible variety of geographical topo-graphy from open plain and valleys to mountainous peaks and deep water fiords.

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. Limited Rights Available: Worldwide, Free TV Only

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Spanning the western length of Colombia, the Chocó region is thought to be one of most biodiverse places on the planet. When the Andes Mountains rose around 60 million years ago they isolated this wild coast creating a haven for evolution. It is the wettest place on earth, on average 13m of water falls every year. Combined with the varied topography of the Western Andes and the year round tropical heat, it is the perfect environment for species to adapt and evolve.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: For every baby animal born, billions don't make it. Drought, flood, famine and predation; babies are born into a harsh world. The odds are so heavily stacked against some animals that it's a miracle any of their youngsters survive at-all. In this episode we discover the incredible lengths that nature's parents go to in order to ensure their progeny's survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: In the middle of Colombia, lies an ancient, unique and little explored outcrop of sandstone; the Serrania de la Macarena. It forms part of the country's first ever national park - made up of lush jungle, shrubland and savannah, isolated peaks, winding rivers and spectacular waterfalls - where more than 15 million specimens were collected during early studies of the area. Called the 'treasure of the world', scientists believe it is a hugely important bank of biological diversity.

programme.title: May (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: While we celebrate may day, the coming of summer, there are many changes going on in the world. As snows finally melt in the mountains of Europe, chamois lambs have the chance to test out their climbing skills and explore their vertical home, watching all the time for eagles, their main predators. On the vast plains of the Russian the weird looking saiga antelope have their calves, while Florida enters its fire season and even the everglades can burn

programme.title: These Birds Are Made For Walking
programme.desc: Few things are more wondrous than the gift of flight, but some birds have chosen to give it up - the question is, why? Whether it's to save energy, tap into new food resources or invest in other skills, they all have their reasons. But one thing's for sure: it doesn't make flightless birds any less weird and wonderful. There are 60 species of bird that have given up the gift of flight, but they are not all related. Each have taken their own evolutionary path.

programme.title: Coasts - Rolling with the Waves
programme.desc: We love our coasts, and so do animals! The corridor of water where the open ocean transitions into coastal habitat is known as the surf zone. The churning forces of the waves clashing with the land make these some of the most food-rich waters on Earth. Nutrients are both washed off the coast from rain and rivers, but also pushed up from the depths thanks to waves and currents.

programme.title: Extinction! Going, going, gone!
programme.desc: Extinction, a daunting and confusing word. A force of nature, that sees the end of species, but also heralds the birth of others. Right now the extinction rate could be as much as 10,000 times faster than it should be. 20% of fish, a fifth of all reptiles and a quarter of mammals face extinction. If we are to do anything to stem the tide of extinction we must understand the lifestyles of those in danger.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: Many animals have evolved chemicals to enhance their chance of survival: some scorpions literally drug their potential mates, others use their poisons to defend or kill. The world of venoms and poisons, the apparatus designed to deliver the payload and the strategies that animals employ to use them most effectively is a rich and varied example of natural selection and evolution in action.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah runs a health check on two female cheetahs with veterinarian Maaike. She then goes into the wilderness with Naankuse founder Marlice. Together they go in search of the elephant Apollo, which was resettled in the sanctuary. The former "problem" elephant now leads a peaceful life here.

programme.title: Seasons Of The Otter
programme.desc: One of the most loves animals, famed for its playful nature and incredible underwater agility. Yet most of the life of the otter goes unseen. Following the first year in the life of a young otter family, we'll reveal the secrets of the otter's world. Otter life is often a challenge, and especially so for a young family trying to make it through winter. Two pups were born last spring, and as they approach their first birthdays the time with their mother is coming to its end.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This unique arctic city is home over 2000 moose! And these notorious animals are running riot... Crossing busy highways, giving birth in backyards, and even doing battle, right here in suburbia! But life on the streets is fraught with danger...and in this expanding city, more highways mean more moose deaths. But the people of Anchorage are on a mission, to protect the most iconic animal in this Wild City.

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In episode two we take a look at Maui and Moloka'i. In the middle of the archipelago they form the heart of Hawaii. The second largest island of Hawai'i - Maui - is a true paradise for surfers. Archie Kalepa was one of the first big wave surfers and is still chasing the thrill today. The ukulele represents the sound of the islands like no other instrument. Eric Devine has been building the plucked string instrument for 20 years. In Kula he goes in search of the perfect wood.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Elephant human conflict has been going on in India for decades. Only now it has increased because of the shrinking forests and the expanding human habitation. North Bengal with it's fragmented habitat of tea gardens, human habitation and paddy fields is a hot bed of conflict. We follow an elephant flying squad which is responsible for keeping the elephants away from these human dominated landscapes.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts
programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In nature, competition for territory is so extreme that some animals have resorted to living in incredible hostile conditions. From brutal cold, to extreme heat, from the ocean depths, to the driest of deserts, this episode showcases some incredible survival stories in the world's most inhospitable environments.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: 96% of Egypt's lands are sun-blistered desert. Rock and sand dominate this country, creating a beautiful but hostile environment. Yet it was home to the Worlds greatest ancient civilisation, which flourished for millennia and still captivates us today. These harsh lands also hold amazing animals that can survive and even thrive, able to cope with and profit from the searing temperatures and lack of moisture.

programme.title: Lion - Africa's Super Power
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: Ten years ago, an inexperienced coal miner named Tom Hanniger caused an accident that killed five men and put a sixth, Harry Warden, into a coma. A year later, on Valentine's Day, Harry woke up and murdered 22 people with a pickaxe before dying. Now Tom has returned home, still haunted by the past. And something else is back in Harmony: a pickaxe-wielding killer in a miner's mask, who may be the ghost of Harry, come to claim Tom and his friends.

As Alice's behavior becomes more and more concerning, Jessica intervenes only to realize that Chauncey is much more than the stuffed toy bear she believed him to be.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: True-crime writer Ellison Oswald is in a slump; he hasn't had a bestseller in more than 10 years and is becoming increasingly desperate for a hit. So, when he discovers the existence of a snuff film showing the deaths of a family, he vows to solve the mystery. He moves his own family into the victims' home and gets to work. However, when old film footage and other clues hint at the presence of a supernatural force, Ellison learns that living in the house may be fatal.

Edward casts his lot with them in the hope of perfecting the cure before it's too late.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.desc: The Roman Catholic Church combats a global rise in demonic possessions by reopening schools to train priests to perform exorcisms. Although nuns are forbidden to perform this ritual, a professor recognizes Sister Ann's gifts and agrees to train her. Thrust onto the spiritual frontline, she soon finds herself in a battle for the soul of a young girl who's possessed by the same demon that tormented her own mother years earlier.

programme.title: Shadow of the Vampire
programme.desc: F. W. Murnau (John Malkovich) is struggling to create his silent classic "Nosferatu" on location in Eastern Europe. The director is obsessed with making this the most authentic vampire movie ever. To that end, Murnau has employed a real vampire, Max Schreck (Willem Dafoe), explaining to the crew that he is the ultimate of that new breed, the "method actor" -- trained by Stanislavsky himself. Schreck will appear only in character and only at night.

programme.title: Imaginary
programme.desc: When Jessica moves back into her childhood home with her family, her youngest stepdaughter, Alice, finds a stuffed bear named Chauncey. As Alice's behavior becomes more and more concerning, Jessica intervenes only to realize that Chauncey is much more than the stuffed toy bear she believed him to be.

programme.title: Vivarium
programme.desc: Hoping to find the perfect place to live, a couple travel to a suburban neighborhood in which all the houses look identical. But when they try to leave the labyrinth-like development, each road mysteriously takes them back to where they started.

programme.title: The Last Exorcism
programme.desc: After years of gulling the faithful, cleric Cotton Marcus feels remorse and decides to expose his chicanery through filming a documentary. With a crew in tow, Marcus arrives at the Louisiana farm of devout Louis Sweetzer, who believes that his daughter, Nell, is possessed. When the usual stunts fail, he realizes that he is face-to-face with real evil and must summon true faith to protect Nell, the others and himself from demonic power.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the Conrad-Caldwell Castle, the masterpiece built by well-known architect, Arthur Loomis. The house took 3 years to complete and was the symbol of success for the original owner, Theophilus Conrad and his wife, who started out as poor immigrants before working their way up to being wealthy industrialists. The couple lived in this home for ten years, before Mr. Conrad died of a heart attack on the basement stairs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Lenox, Massachusetts to investigate The Mount, a location they first visited in 2008. Built in 1902, the Mount was designed and built for Pulitzer Prize winning author, Edith Wharton and her husband, Teddy. When their marriage started to fall apart in 1911, the couple moved out and eventually divorced. This renowned property is where Edith wrote many of her best sellers, and had famous friends visit, including Henry James.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Boston, Massachusetts to investigate the USS Constitution, the oldest commissioned warship still afloat in the world and one that also never lost a battle. She was built in 1794 and decommissioned in 1855, then placed in permanent commission in 1940. Today she holds a crew of 60, but at a peak time, during the War of 1812, she had 450-500 people aboard: including 60 marines, 350-400 sailors, and 50 officers/ship boys.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to North Adams, Massachusetts to investigate Houghton Mansion. It was built in 1897 for North Adams' first Mayor, A.C Houghton. Constructed on the foundation of a previous home, The Houghton Mansion was used for the family and fundraisers. The hauntings are said to have begun in 1914 after a tragic car accident took the lives of A.C Houghton and his daughter. His chauffer was driving and was so overcome with guilt that he took his own life the next day. A week later Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Glen Spey, New York to investigate Burn Brae Mansion, which was formerly the summer home of Margaret and Charles Elkin. It was constructed in the early 1900's by Margaret, who was one of seven MacKenzie siblings to build a grand estate in Glen Spey with the money given to her by her father. Several of Charles and Margaret's children passed away young, and their coachman, William attempted suicide on the property, and later died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out by two clients to investigate the Midwest Railway Preservation Society in Cleveland, Ohio. Built in 1907, this rail yard had over 400 people working there 24/7. Some of the jobs were very dangerous with a number of injuries and deaths taking place over the years, with the brakeman being one of the most dangerous. Sometimes people fell off the tops of the trains and died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the season premiere of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cleveland, Ohio to investigate Grays Armory. It was built in 1893 to house the men's only Grays militia force, a force that was to protect the city of Cleveland from any unrest, as there was no National Guard at that point in time. The gray color was chosen to honor the New York grey's for being victorious during the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Detroit, Michigan to investigate The Whitney. Originally built in 1890 by lumber baron David Whitney, it was used as a private residence for him and his second wife, Sarah, along with his four children. At the time the house was built he was the wealthiest man in Detroit, and spared no expense in his home, including adding the first personal use elevator, and $400,000 worth of furnishings from two trips to Europe. Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Toledo, Ohio to investigate the Toledo Yacht Club. Susan Hurst has called the guys in to investigate the club, which first opened in 1865. A fire destroyed it in 1906 and it was rebuilt in 1908. It became well known during the prohibition era, as bootleggers used the docks to smuggle Canadian booze across Lake Erie.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Steve's hometown of New Bedford, Massachusetts to investigate Fort Taber-Fort Rodman. In the 1770's New Bedford was home to many Colony Pirates and in 1778 the Navy launched a raid on New Bedford on the same spot the fort sits today. Three colonists were killed and New Bedford was burned to the ground.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays local as they investigate the Varnum Memorial Armory in East Greenwich, Rhode Island. The armory was built in 1913 by the Varnum Continentals, Inc., a group that works to preserve the Rhode Island military history, and was to be used as a clubhouse and meeting hall for them. There are no reported deaths on the property, but they did hold wakes for soldiers that died during WWI and WWII.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called in to investigate Old Lake County Jail, in Crown Pint, Indiana. Originally built in 1882, the jail had 10 cells plus the attached sheriff house, which was required by Indiana law to have the Sheriff reside next to or in front of the jail. The prison went through two expansions, the first in 1908 and the second in 1928. At its peak the jail could hold 150 prisoners.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Valparaiso, Indiana to investigate the Inn at Aberdeen. The house dates back to the 1850's and was purchased by the Ritter family, who were thought to be involved in the Underground Railroad. The house changed ownership over the years until the client, John, purchased it in 1995. Since then reports of paranormal activity have been accumulating.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays close to home by investigating the Westerly Library, in Westerly, Rhode Island. In 1892 Steven and Harriett Wilcox agreed to fund an in memoriam library in horror of Civil War soldiers. The library was completed in 1894, but unfortunately Mr. Wilcox did not live long enough to see it completed. The library has grown to over 50,000 square feet and has been designated as Rhode Island's first literary landmark.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.
programme.sub-title: Give Me Liberty or Give Me Corpses

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to the Garde Arts Center in New London, Connecticut. The Center is the former site of the Williams Family Mansion, built in1831 by Thomas Wheeler Williams. Mr. Williams was a congressman and part of the whaling community; in a city know as the "Whaling City." Thomas Wheeler Williams married twice having a total of 9 children. Tragically 5 of Thomas's children died under the age of 22yrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Cornwall Bridge, Connecticut to investigate the Vogel Residence. Their client, Robin Vogel, is afraid that the Curse Of Dudleytown has spread to her home and has asked TAPS to help. Dudleytown was an abandoned settlement that dates back to the 1740's. Many people believe the settlement was cursed due to the fact that many inhabitants died a violent death or went insane. The Vogel Residence was originally built in 1780 with an addition put on in 1830.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Wilmington, Delaware to investigate Rockwood Museum. They are joined by two of their paranormal friends: actors Rachel Nichols, and Jonathan Sadowski. The original owner of the mansion was Joseph Shipley. He was born into a wealthy family in Wilmington, but made his own money as a merchant banker in Liverpool, England. He built Rockwood Mansion in 1854 to resemble his Liverpool home, Wyncote.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: We are introduced to Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson, co-founders and lead investigators for The Atlantic Paranormal Society (TAPS). Their Technical Manager, Brian Harnois, tells them of an interesting case. The home they are to investigate is in Altoona, PA which is several hours away, but because of the dramatic nature of the case they decide to make the long drive. They investigate reports of poltergeist activity in a home with a very young girl who seems to see the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates the historic Mishler Theatre and the Altoona Railroaders Memorial Museum. At the theater, the owner and employees have seen the late owner walking into the wall where his old office used to be, sitting in the seats, and have heard him walking on the catwalk above the stage. At the museum, the spirit of a railroad worker has been seen. Despite some orb activity in the theater, neither site presents any good evidence of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates The Lighthouse Inn in New London, Conn., which is reported to be haunted by the ghost of a bride who fell down a flight of stairs on her wedding day in 1930. Drops in temperature are recorded, and Steve feels someone touch him on his back when no one else is nearby. They then travel to Ashland, Mass. to a pub called Stone's Public House, formerly The Railroad House. Here, a little girl died after being hit by a train.
programme.sub-title: Lighthouse Inn and John Stone Tarvern / The Lighthouse Inn

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: At the request of the US Coast Guard, TAPS goes to Long Island Sound to investigate the Race Rock Lighthouse. The lighthouse is now automated, but the Coast Guard officers who come to do maintenance and inspection have reported strange occurrences and are nervous about going to the site. The commanding officers hope to disprove the rumors. The team's cameras pick up strange orb activity and a fog which the investigators do not remember from the time of the video.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates Eastern State Penitentiary, an abandoned prison with a long, colorful history and a reputation for paranormal activity. While there, they capture a strange, shadowy shape on film. After reviewing the film, Jason decides that the team should return. More orbs are caught on film, but no repeat of the shadowy figure. Efforts to duplicate the footage prove unsuccessful, but Jason and Grant see how it could have been done.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This investigation focuses on some friends of Brian's whose home is a deconsecrated 19th century church. They claim to have seen apparitions and to have heard strange noises. Also, one of the doors in the house opens by itself. The investigation turns up only orbs caused by dust. Jason determines that the sounds and orbs are caused by the settling of the wood beams when the church bell rings. The team is able to duplicate the opening door, giving a mundane explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to investigate an armory in New Bedford, Mass. In one room, the thermal imaging camera detects a warm mist passing in front of the lens. This is very strange, because mists are generally colder than the surrounding air. While moving along a catwalk, sound man Frank DeAngelis suddenly falls down and does not feel well enough to move for quite some time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Reports of disturbances in a college student group house are easily explained as acoustics and encounters with neighbors who were drunk at the time. At the Topton House Pub, witnesses have reported that the ghost of a little girl sometimes trips people on the steps and has moved glasses of soda on one table. The daughter of the owner has also smelled roses while in the cellar and heard murmurring voices.
programme.sub-title: Fortuna Apartment, Topton House, & Frank's Interview / Fortuna & Topton

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Mike Sinclair, the founder of O.R.I.O.N. Paranormal and a TAPS family member, has called in TAPS to co-investigate the New Boston Inn, in the Berkshires. After examining his findings, the TAPS team is able to disprove or cast doubt upon, everything he found. However, the experience their own incident when a pen seems to have moved with no one else nearby. Next they travel to Pittsburgh to investigate the home of Gloria and Genny.
programme.sub-title: New Boston Inn & Gloria's House / New Boston Inn

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates two cases. First they go to Albany, NY to the home of Linda Johnson. Linda claims to be psychically sensitive, and to have been accosted by a negative or ""demonic"" entity. No conclusive evidence is found, but Jason suggests that Keith Johnson contact her separately to try to help further. Next, they meet Adam Zubrowski, who seems to be experiencing strange events. The house was built by his grandparents, and his grandfather died there.
programme.sub-title: Johnson House & Zubrowski House / The Negative Entity

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to New Orleans to investigate one of the "most haunted" places in the U.S., and Brian's new relationship interferes with his work causing tension with TAPS members. They capture an image on their thermal camera and discover a lamp that moves on its own. Jason and Grant both agree that the plantation is haunted.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS helps a family whose young children claim to be tormented by ghosts. They find bones under the floorboards. After further analysis, the bones are not human but animal and the footage shows that the little boy, not ghosts, is waking up his sister in the middle of the night. Then TAPS helps a young woman who is experiencing lots of paranormal activity in her home. Jason is attacked and TAPS concludes that the entity is focused on the young woman.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to New Orleans for a case with a jealous female spirit who won't leave the male homeowner alone. They find evidence that supports the victim's claims when they viewfootage of a door that opens and shuts on its own. While in town, they go to Brennan's restaurant for a meal and some ghost hunting. But their EVPs are tainted by noises that are coming from a private party.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian can't go on this road trip. A training mission in North Carolina goes awry when team members get food poisoning. A local ghost hunting group asks TAPS for help with a haunted battleship. Jason and Grant are chased through the bowels of the ship. There are a lot of personal experiences but the team fails to capture anything on tape. The results are inconclusive.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian asks Jason and Grant for some time off. TAPS visits a local playhouse with a long history of hauntings but their investigation doesn't yield any evidence. Then they head over to a firehouse where the paranormal activity is spooking some of the volunteer firemen. Jason and Grant have an odd experience with a stereo that turns itself on. Andy tries to debunk some alarms that get tripped on their own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian leaves TAPS. Andy persuades Jason and Grant to investigate a haunted lighthouse. Steve and Andy experience a cold spot but nothing else happens. Jason and Grant tell Andy he should be more diligent with his case studies. TAPS travel to New York for a haunted museum. Andy gets in a tiff with the other members. The team doesn't capture any evidence of a haunting.
programme.sub-title: New London Lighthouse & Merchant's House Museum

programme.title: Of Trees & Forests: The Invisible World
programme.desc: At the northernmost reaches of the world stretches the largest continuous expanse of vegetation on the planet: the boreal forest. At the boundary between shadow and light, temperatures are extreme, and living beings have adapted to survive. In this vast woodland, the birch tree stands out. Its white bark is a powerful insulator, and its roots, in alliance with symbiotic fungi in the soil, protect it from underground threats.

programme.title: Of Trees & Forests: The Invisible World
programme.desc: At the edge of the boreal forest, where the light shines through, a sacred tree watches over the taiga: the birch. For the people of the Far North, this axis of the world prevents the universe from collapsing.

programme.title: Of Trees & Forests: The Invisible World

programme.title: Of Trees & Forests: The Invisible World

Ezra Lieberman (Laurence Olivier), a Nazi hunter, learns of the plan and is determined to thwart it. When the two meet face-to-face in the home of one of the Hitler clones, it is up to the boy to choose who he will assist.

When hunting guide Jack Hewitt (Jim True) reports a businessman's accidental death during a hunting trip, Wade believes he has a chance to turn around his life, if he can prove it was murder. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. programme.title: Silent House

Long vacant, the house has no utilities, forcing the trio to rely on battery-operated lanterns to light their way. Sarah becomes separated from her relatives and soon finds she is trapped inside the cabin, with no contact with the outside world. Panic turns to real terror as the young woman experiences events that become increasingly ominous.

programme.title: House
programme.desc: In an effort to avoid spending time with her father and his creepy new lover, young Gorgeous (Kimiko Ikegami) resolves to visit her aunt's remote mansion. With six of her closest friends in tow, including the musically inclined Melody (Eriko Tanaka) and the geeky Prof (Ai Matsubara), Gorgeous arrives at the estate, where supernatural events occur almost immediately. A severed head takes flight, household appliances come to life and a portrait of a cat seems to contain an evil spirit.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: Black Sabbath
programme.desc: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

programme.title: Dog Soldiers
programme.desc: During a routine nighttime training mission in the Scottish Highlands, a small squad of British soldiers expected to rendezvous with a special ops unit instead find a bloody massacre with a sole survivor. The savage attackers of the special ops team return, and the men are rescued by Megan, a zoologist who identifies what hunts them as werewolves. Without transport or communications, the group is forced to retreat to a farmhouse to wait for the full moon to disappear at dawn.

programme.title: The Stepfather
programme.desc: Jerry Blake (Terry O'Quinn) is a family man, but he happens to have a series of families, with each one on the receiving end of his murderous ways. When Jerry sets his sights on a lovely widow named Susan (Shelley Hack) and her headstrong daughter, Stephanie (Jill Schoelen), it appears that his brutal pattern of killings will continue. However, Stephanie begins to suspect that there's something wrong with the seemingly well-adjusted Jerry, and a violent confrontation is inevitable.

programme.title: Funny Games
programme.desc: An idyllic lakeside vacation home is terrorized by Paul (Arno Frisch) and Peter (Frank Giering), a pair of deeply disturbed young men. When the fearful Anna (Susanne Lothar) is home alone, the two men drop by for a visit that quickly turns violent and terrifying. Husband Georg (Ulrich Mühe) comes to her rescue, but Paul and Peter take the family hostage and subject them to nightmarish abuse and humiliation. From time to time, Paul talks to the film's audience, making it complicit in the horror.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The most dangerous snakes, sports, weather events; America's most dangerous volcano; tornado hazards; base jumping.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Trace the butchering trade's evolution from corner butchers to industrial disassembly lines; tour Chicago Stockyards remains where Sinclair, Birdseye, and refrigeration changed the industry, plus modern quality controls and rural custom butchers.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Satellites and the Global Positioning System spark a revolution in cartography.

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
